newsitem.title: USA: ETrade plans $25 million ad campaign.
newsitem.headline: ETrade plans $25 million ad campaign.

text.p: ETrade Group Chief Executive Officer Christos Cotsakos said the company plans a $25 million advertising campaign this autumn to boost ETrade's online brokerage and commerce business.

Cotsakos also said in a presentation to investors at a Robertson Stephens & Co investor conference that the company is working on partnering deals in the Pacific region, including China, but he declined to elaborate.
The fall advertisements will build on the company's "in your face" style developed in its earlier "boot your broker" advertising themes.
Samples of the new advertisements displayed pictures of lavish homes or expensive luxury cars.
"Your investments paid for this house in Greenwich, Connecticut - too bad it belongs to your broker," said one of the sample advertisements.

ETrade executives said they had saved more money per transaction from its investment in self-clearing, which they said had paid back its investment in less than five months instead of the seven they had projected.
